page: Microsoft Azure L8s_v3 is a storage-optimized virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon 8370C processor utilizing x86_64 architecture, providing 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs via simultaneous multithreading. Memory allocation is set at 64.0 GB of RAM, offering an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. A central hardware feature is the inclusion of 2006 GB of direct-attached local NVMe SSD storage, designed to accommodate I/O-intensive database and filesystem tasks without adding separate managed disk volumes. Graphical processing units are not present on this instance type.

Benchmark evaluations indicate consistent mid-tier performance across computational and memory operations. Stress-ng returned 1899.79 on single-core and 7762.97 on multi-core testing, while Geekbench recorded a single-core score of 1558.0 and a multi-core score of 5787.0. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth reached 57.87 GB/sec, alongside a write speed of 37.8 GB/sec. Application testing demonstrates 8.0 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads and 11.85 GB/sec static web serving throughput. A slight bottleneck appears in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, scoring 31.27 GB/sec in the lower quartile, reflecting constrained core parallelism relative to compute-focused architectures.

From an architectural standpoint, the server provides strong resource consolidation for workloads requiring direct high-speed local disk capacity paired with high memory density. Because local NVMe storage is integrated directly, the instance delivers high I/O throughput without extra storage overhead. It is well suited for transactional databases, distributed NoSQL datastores, Elasticsearch nodes, and data caching tiers that benefit from rapid local NVMe throughput and 64 GB of memory.
description: Microsoft Azure L8s_v3 is a storage-optimized instance running on an Intel Xeon 8370C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores at 2.8 GHz, alongside 64.0 GB of memory (8.0 GB per core) and 2006 GB of fast local NVMe SSD storage. The instance features no GPU accelerators. In standardized benchmarks, the L8s_v3 demonstrates consistent mid-range results across compute and memory operations, including a Geekbench multi-core score of 5787.0 and 8.0 million Redis SET operations per second, though multi-threaded decompression reflects the constraints of its 8-thread limit. Offering substantial integrated NVMe capacity, the instance eliminates external disk latency for data-intensive systems, making it appropriate for transactional databases, NoSQL clusters, caching layers, and search index workloads.
